projects.title: End-to-End Supply Chain Optimization
projects.description: GroEdge partnered with a Tier-1 automotive supplier to redesign their procurement-to-delivery flow, reducing lead times and inventory while improving on-time delivery.

projects.title: Lean Operations Transformation
projects.description: A full lean transformation engagement focusing on value stream mapping, waste elimination, and standard work across production and support functions.
achievements: 40% improvement in throughput in key product lines
Setup time reduced by 60% on critical equipment
Staff trained and certified in lean fundamentals

projects.title: Warehouse & Distribution Centre Redesign
projects.description: Redesigned layout, slotting, and picking processes for a 80,000 sq ft distribution centre to support 30% volume growth without proportional cost increase.
achievements: Labour cost per order reduced by 25%
Safety incidents reduced to zero over 12 months

projects.title: Operational Due Diligence & Integration
projects.description: Operational due diligence for an acquisition followed by post-merger integration support to consolidate two manufacturing sites and align processes.
achievements: Successful consolidation of two sites within 8 months
Unified ERP and reporting within first year
Zero disruption to key customer deliveries
